cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Who Cares More?
cards.instruction: Turn every favor, memory, sacrifice, and affectionate gesture into evidence that you care more.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm putting our holiday things in order. I've kept twelve tickets. How many did you keep?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Mine are in the album I made you. Don't pull it apart.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The album stays whole. I'll find it a box; apparently I'm keeping both our memories safe.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I bought a box for it. It's under the table.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll fetch it. You pack the album; I'll carry it upstairs. I wouldn't ask you to risk your back for our memories.

reason: Repair the conflicting ticket count and replace status padding with negotiated album handling; B box contribution prompts A to claim the greater personal sacrifice through carrying.
